question:
**Direction: The sentence given below has one misspelt word. Spot the INCORRECTLY spelt word and select its correct spelling.**

Too much bureacracy suppresses creativity
solution:
The correct answer is **"Bureaucracy."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is** 'Bureaucracy.'**
 
• The misspelt word is **'Bureacracy.'**
